f3_program: collection("oliver.laundry_shop.earnings.three_days", "daily_earning", "oliver.laundry_shop", source("How much did he earn for three days?"))
observe(at("oliver.laundry_shop.charge_rate", "current"), 2, "dollar_per_kilogram", source("he charges $2 per kilo of laundry"))
observe(at("oliver.laundry_shop.laundry_weight", "two_days_ago"), 5, "kilogram", source("Two days ago, his shop washed a total of 5 kilos of laundries"))

offset(at("oliver.laundry_shop.laundry_weight", "yesterday"), at("oliver.laundry_shop.laundry_weight", "two_days_ago"), 5, "kilogram", source("Yesterday, it washed five kilos of laundries more than the previous day"))
multiple(at("oliver.laundry_shop.laundry_weight", "today"), at("oliver.laundry_shop.laundry_weight", "yesterday"), 2, source("Today, it washed twice the number of kilos than yesterday"))
member("oliver.laundry_shop.earnings.three_days", "oliver.laundry_shop.earnings.three_days.two_days_ago", source("Two days ago, his shop washed a total of 5 kilos of laundries"))
member("oliver.laundry_shop.earnings.three_days", "oliver.laundry_shop.earnings.three_days.yesterday", source("Yesterday, it washed five kilos of laundries more than the previous day"))
member("oliver.laundry_shop.earnings.three_days", "oliver.laundry_shop.earnings.three_days.today", source("Today, it washed twice the number of kilos than yesterday"))

rate_relation(at("oliver.laundry_shop.earnings.three_days.two_days_ago", "current"), at("oliver.laundry_shop.charge_rate", "current"), at("oliver.laundry_shop.laundry_weight", "two_days_ago"), source("he charges $2 per kilo of laundry"))

rate_relation(at("oliver.laundry_shop.earnings.three_days.yesterday", "current"), at("oliver.laundry_shop.charge_rate", "current"), at("oliver.laundry_shop.laundry_weight", "yesterday"), source("he charges $2 per kilo of laundry"))

rate_relation(at("oliver.laundry_shop.earnings.three_days.today", "current"), at("oliver.laundry_shop.charge_rate", "current"), at("oliver.laundry_shop.laundry_weight", "today"), source("he charges $2 per kilo of laundry"))
query("sum", "oliver.laundry_shop.earnings.three_days", "current")
collection("kelly.supplies", "school_supply", "kelly", source("Kelly needs school supplies"))
observe(at("kelly.class.students.count", "current"), 8, "count", source("She has 8 students"))
observe(at("kelly.supplies.construction_paper.per_student.count", "current"), 3, "piece_per_student", source("they will need 3 pieces of construction paper each"))

product_relation(at("kelly.supplies.construction_paper.count", "initial"), at("kelly.class.students.count", "current"), at("kelly.supplies.construction_paper.per_student.count", "current"), source("She has 8 students and they will need 3 pieces of construction paper each"))
observe(at("kelly.supplies.glue_bottles.count", "initial"), 6, "count", source("she needs to buy 6 bottles of glue"))

sum_relation(at("kelly.supplies.count", "initial"), at("kelly.supplies.construction_paper.count", "initial"), at("kelly.supplies.glue_bottles.count", "initial"), source("they will need 3 pieces of construction paper each. In addition to the construction paper, she needs to buy 6 bottles of glue for everyone to share"))
remove("storm_drain_drop", "kelly", at("kelly.supplies.count", "current"), fraction(at("kelly.supplies.count", "initial"), 1, 2), source("she dropped half of them down a storm drain"))
add("additional_construction_paper_purchase", "kelly", at("kelly.supplies.count", "current"), 5, source("she manages to rush to the store and buy 5 more pieces of construction paper"))
query("value", at("kelly.supplies.count", "current"))
collection("party.attendees", "person", "late-night party", source("50 people at the party"))
observe(at("party.attendees.count", "current"), 50, "count", source("there were 50 people at the party"))
observe(at("party.contribution_per_attendee", "current"), 100, "dollar_per_attendee", source("each attendee had to pay $100"))
rate_relation(at("party.total_contributions.amount", "current"), at("party.contribution_per_attendee", "current"), at("party.attendees.count", "current"), source("each attendee had to pay $100"))
offset(at("party.total_expenses.amount", "current"), at("party.total_contributions.amount", "current"), -500, "dollar", source("the total expenses were $500 less than the total contributions"))
query("value", at("party.total_expenses.amount", "current"))
collection("jeff_and_vicki.pencils", "pencil", "jeff and vicki", source("Jeff had 300 pencils and donated 30% of them. Vicki had twice as many pencils as Jeff"))
observe(at("jeff_and_vicki.pencils.jeff.count", "initial"), 300, "count", source("Jeff had 300 pencils"))

remove("jeff_donation", "jeff", at("jeff_and_vicki.pencils.jeff.count", "current"), fraction(at("jeff_and_vicki.pencils.jeff.count", "initial"), 30, 100), source("Jeff had 300 pencils and donated 30% of them"))
multiple(at("jeff_and_vicki.pencils.vicki.count", "initial"), at("jeff_and_vicki.pencils.jeff.count", "initial"), 2, source("Vicki had twice as many pencils as Jeff"))

remove("vicki_donation", "vicki", at("jeff_and_vicki.pencils.jeff.count", "current"), fraction(at("jeff_and_vicki.pencils.jeff.count", "current"), 3, 4), source("Vicki had twice as many pencils as Jeff and donated 3/4 of his pencils"))
query("remaining_count", "jeff_and_vicki.pencils", "current")
assumptions: The possessive "his pencils" is resolved to Jeff as written, and the donation events follow the narrative order.
